name: DCA Corn Dog Castle Original Hand-Dipped Corn Dog or Cheddar Cheese Stick
brandOrRestaurant: Corn Dog Castle (Paradise Gardens Park · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: cheddar cheese stick corn dog castle
whyItWorks: Smooth, seedless cornmeal-wheat batter dipped around a mild frankfurter or block of aged cheddar cheese—strictly avoid the spicy Hot-Link Corn Dog.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the **Original Corn Dog** (or Cheddar Cheese Stick) with chips—never order the spicy Hot-Link Corn Dog—and peel off part of the fried batter if sensitive to oil.
watchOuts: Avoid the Hot-Link Corn Dog (spicy cayenne sausage); blot excess fryer oil
